purpose: Deploy and troubleshoot the GitHub Release download-counter Cloudflare Worker.
notes: Inspect worker-code.js and its route parameters. Query existing public release counts; do not invent authenticated administration endpoints or deploy account-wide Cloudflare changes.
purpose_zh: 部署和排查 GitHub Release 下载数统计的 Cloudflare Worker。
notes_zh: 先检查 worker-code.js 的真实路由参数；查询已有公开 Release 下载数，不虚构管理接口或改动账户范围的 Cloudflare 设置。
